# tier 2, group lock60, route pipe, version payload 1.3, role ab
# Against pipe1 and pipe2. Read [fps] LOCKED 60 (policy 60 from the start), [lane] (game, send, back end, GPU ms), [lock60] step down/step up lines (levels, size, reason, GPU ms), [lock60] scene lines (preset, floor, ready rungs), [lock60] 30 s lines, [frame-timing] p50 and the late-frame count (frames over 16.7 ms). Pass: p50 16.7, late under 2 %, no step line in a calm stretch longer than 10 s, no [lock60] line saying a step made objects (the one that begins `the step to level`). By eye: the pitch and players at the play floor (0.70). r17 pass rule (plan-wave17 section 3 + split17 + head17): p50 16.7 ms, late under 2 %, no relief in open play, `[head]` game-thread p95 under 14.5 ms, and `[split] held == finished, leaked 0` (INVALID if the `[head]` or `[split]` line is missing: MSC_HEAD_STAT=1 is in the env).
